description: Paper memecoin book requested by the user ('based off Twitter posts'). Reading X costs money (about $0.005 per post), so it does not read tweets: its attention inputs are free and public (GeckoTerminal trending pools, DexScreener boosted tokens and profiles that carry an X link, the pool's own trade counts) and a RugCheck safety screen. Rules: Solana pools with real liquidity and volume, aged 4 h to 7 days, that are trending or have an X link, entered on confirmed momentum (1h +8..+60%, not fading in the last 5 minutes, buys outnumber sells), then fixed exits (stop, take-profit, trailing stop, time stop, liquidity-collapse). Fills are modeled pessimistically: swap fee, latency/MEV allowance and price impact on entry; wider slippage on stops; exits happen at the price seen on the next run, not at the trigger price; a token whose pool cannot be found for 3 runs is written off at zero. Forward test only: there is no historical memecoin tape to test on, so there is no evidence this works. Most memecoin traders lose money. No profit claim.
